patch_description: Test radius_scale=0.75 while retaining velocities. Increasing the radius from 1.0 to 1.5 slightly worsened mean development error with retained velocities, motivating a probe below 1.0. A smaller relocation radius may preserve useful local search structure while retained momentum supplies additional movement. This constant policy isolates radius tuning; improved performance would neither establish overshoot as the mechanism nor demonstrate transfer without fresh-case evaluation.
